Class SpringAiOllamaLlmService

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.SpringAiOllamaLlmService
All Implemented Interfaces:
LlmProvider, LlmService
@Service public class SpringAiOllamaLlmService extends Object implements LlmService, LlmProvider
The SpringAiOllamaLlmService class is the Ollama backend for one chat completion. The class implements LlmService and LlmProvider. It holds a chat model, an API bean, a context-window integer, and a configured model id. A caller asks for one completion. A set think option with a sink and a text-only prompt streams through the shared API. Think left unset, a null sink, or a prompt that is not text-only stays on the one-shot chat-model call.

    • complete

      public org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse complete(org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, String model, String think, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The complete method chooses a stream or a one-shot call. The model text is trimmed. A null model becomes an empty string. thinkOptionOf(String) turns the think text into an option. If the option is null, the sink is null, or textOnly(Prompt) is false, the method calls callOnce(Prompt, String, ThinkOption). Otherwise the method calls streamThink(Prompt, String, ThinkOption, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink). The text true becomes the enabled think flag. Any other non-empty text except false becomes a think level that carries that text. Empty text and false leave the option unset. This method never returns the disabled boolean flag. The string DISABLED is non-empty and is not false, so it becomes a level. A set option, a sink, and a text-only prompt stream with stream set to true. Each thinking piece goes to the sink as kind t. Kind c is not sent. The joined message content is the reply. The stream request carries the resolved model, the think option, and num_ctx when that integer is greater than 0. The streamed reply uses empty generation metadata, so it has no thinking key. An image, a tool call, or a tool result stays on the one-shot call. The one-shot reply keeps thinking text when the metadata key thinking is present.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The prompt is the assembled request.
      model - The model is the id after ollama/. An empty model keeps the configured model when the stream must resolve one.
      think - The think text is empty or false to leave think unset, true for the enabled flag, or another non-empty text for a level.
      sink - The sink receives kind t pieces. A null sink keeps the one-shot call.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the client returns nothing or the read is stopped.

    • thinkOptionOf

      static org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.ThinkOption thinkOptionOf(String think)
      The thinkOptionOf method turns a think string into the option the request will send. A null string is treated as empty. The text true returns the enabled flag. Any other non-empty text except false returns a level that carries that text. Empty text and false return null, so think stays unset.
      Parameters:
      think - The think text is empty to leave think unset, true for the enabled flag, or another non-empty text for a level.
      Returns:
      The return value is the option to send, or null when think stays unset.

    • textOnly

      static boolean textOnly(org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt)
      The textOnly method reports whether every message is plain system, user, or assistant text. A null prompt returns false. A null instruction list returns true. A null message or a null message type returns false. A user message with media returns false. An assistant message with tool calls returns false. Any other message type returns false.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The prompt is the assembled request.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when every message is plain text.

    • acceptStreamChunk

      static void acceptStreamChunk(org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.OllamaApi.ChatResponse chunk, StringBuilder content, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The acceptStreamChunk method reads one stream frame. A null chunk, a null message, or a null content builder returns without writing. Non-empty thinking goes to the sink as kind t when the sink is present. Non-empty content is appended to the builder and is not sent as its own delta. Kind c is not sent. An empty thinking string and an empty content string are skipped.
      Parameters:
      chunk - The chunk is one stream frame.
      content - The builder holds the joined reply text.
      sink - The sink receives kind t pieces.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the sink stops the read.

    • raiseStreamFailure

      static void raiseStreamFailure(Throwable thrown) throws Exception
      The raiseStreamFailure method unwraps a stream failure and throws it again. GrokLlmService.CallStopped is thrown as itself. A runtime exception is thrown as itself. An error is thrown as itself. A checked exception from the unwrapped cause is thrown as itself. If the unwrapped cause is none of those and the original throwable is an exception, that original exception is thrown. Any other case throws a new exception. A null throwable uses the message Ollama stream failed. Otherwise the new exception uses the throwable message.
      Parameters:
      thrown - The throwable is the failure from the stream pull.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws the stopped read or the provider failure.

    • callOnce

      private org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse callOnce(org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, String modelId, org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.ThinkOption option) throws Exception
      The callOnce method sends one prompt through the chat model. If the model id is non-empty, the context window is above 0, or the think option is set, those values are copied onto a new options object and the prompt is rebuilt. Otherwise the original prompt is sent. A null response throws an exception with the message Ollama returned no response. Thinking text stays in the metadata when the client fills the thinking key.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The prompt is the assembled request.
      modelId - The model id is the trimmed caller model. An empty id keeps the bean model.
      option - The option is the think option, or null when think stays unset.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when the client returns nothing.

    • streamThink

      private org.springframework.ai.chat.model.ChatResponse streamThink(org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt, String modelId, org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.ThinkOption option, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink sink) throws Exception
      The streamThink method pulls each frame on this thread. The sink runs inside acceptStreamChunk(OllamaApi.ChatResponse, StringBuilder, GrokLlmService.DeltaSink) before the next frame is taken. Closing the stream cancels the HTTP call. An empty pull returns empty content and does not throw. A runtime exception from the pull is passed to raiseStreamFailure(Throwable). The reply is built by replyOf(String), so the generation metadata has no thinking text.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The prompt is a text-only request.
      modelId - The model id is the trimmed caller model.
      option - The option is the set think option.
      sink - The sink receives kind t pieces.
      Returns:
      The return value is the completion with empty thinking metadata.
      Throws:
      Exception - The method throws this exception when no model is defined, the read is stopped, or the client fails.

    • streamOptions

      private org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.OllamaChatOptions streamOptions(String callerModel, org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.ThinkOption option) throws GrokLlmService.NoModelException
      The streamOptions method resolves the model and copies the stream options. The caller model is used first. If that text is empty, the chat-model default is used. If that text is also empty, spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.model is used. If every one of those is empty, the method throws GrokLlmService.NoModelException. num_ctx is set when the configured integer is greater than 0. The think option is set on the copy. When the chat-model defaults are Ollama chat options, the copy starts from those defaults. Other bean defaults stay on that copy.
      Parameters:
      callerModel - The caller model is the trimmed model id from the caller.
      option - The option is the set think option.
      Returns:
      The return value is the options object for the stream request.
      Throws:
      GrokLlmService.NoModelException - The method throws this exception when no model is defined.

    • ollamaMessages

      private static List<org.springframework.ai.ollama.api.OllamaApi.Message> ollamaMessages(org.springframework.ai.chat.prompt.Prompt prompt)
      The ollamaMessages method copies plain-text roles into Ollama messages. A null prompt or a null instruction list returns an empty list. A null message is skipped. System, user, and assistant types keep those roles. Any other type throws an illegal-argument exception whose message starts with Unsupported message type: . A null message text is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The prompt is a text-only request.
      Returns:
      The return value is the list of Ollama messages.
